content.text:

element.**cloneNode**() 克隆一个元素并返回生成的节点。
document.**createElement**(element) 创建一个新的元素节点。
document.**createTextNode**(text) 创建一个新的文本节点。

resolved.title: 删除元素
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Removing Elements[/h1][/s0l0!-header] To remove an HTML element, you must select the parent of the element and use the [b]removeChild[/b](node) method. [s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="html" codeId="959"]

This is a paragraph.

This is another paragraph.

[/code] This removes the paragraph with id="p1" from the page. [note]An alternative way of achieving the same result would be the use of the [b]parentNode [/b]property to get the parent of the element we want to remove: var child = document.getElementById("p1"); child.[b]parentNode[/b].removeChild(child);[/note]

content.text:
实现相同结果的另一种方法是使用 **parentNode** 属性来获取我们要删除的元素的父级。

```javascript
var child = document.getElementById("p1");
child.parentNode.removeChild(child)。
```
